title: Why your Genetics don't matter
summary: NH argues that genetics are unfair but mostly irrelevant to naturals. He separates genetic gifts from potential, which is only revealed through years of work, and blames PED users and pro bodybuilding for warped standards. He attacks the blackpill and genetic boasting and proposes Schrodinger's genetics: your potential is undefined until you work.
claims: Demoralization is the bodybuilder's enemy; believing in bad genetics stops people from realizing their potential
Genetics are like poker cards: a good player beats a bad one even with a worse hand
Fixed genetic factors include limb length, frame width, muscle insertions, myostatin and hormonal profile
Genetics are unfair because life follows the laws of competition and nature, but most people aren't afflicted with diseases that justify complaint
Genetic gifts are immediately usable traits (like long arms for deadlifting); genetic potential is expressed through action and time
Comparing yourself to gifted people makes your genetics look bad, but life isn't a race against everyone
Most people saying 'bad genetics' really mean 'bad work ethic'; potential is only revealed through work
At 15-16 he was skinny, narrow-shouldered, wide-waisted with small limbs, and still unimpressive three years into training
Judging potential from how skinny or fat you are as a teen is idiotic
Freaks with great genetics exist but are rare, and irrelevant unless you compete with them; most people are average and that's fine
He considers himself average to below average genetically
Pro bodybuilders looked like regular kids before drugs; their size came from years of drugs
A natural's hormonal profile isn't fixed; total testosterone keeps rising into the 20s-30s, so a 15-year-old's genetics haven't expressed yet
Without training he'd still be 150-160 lb at six feet, about 60 lb lighter; training boosted his hormonal profile
PED users destroyed standards: some think everyone is natural and expect pro looks in two years, others think anyone jacked is on steroids
There are more dishonest frauds than honest people on YouTube fitness
He never looked up to any physique; anime and manga inspired him and he was his own standard, with no limit
Pros inject the hormonal profile, the biggest genetic factor for naturals, so they obsess over insertions and frames that don't matter to you
Kids saying they have bad genetics after under two years of training can't know
The idea of reaching your natural limit in three years (30 months) is absurd
Genetics only start to matter once you're advanced and can assess weak and strong points while sculpting; novices whine most but should care least
Genetics is the perfect invisible culprit: blaming it means blaming your ancestors or calling yourself a waste of talent
Being skinny at 30 after five years of 'training' means you don't train hard or know how to train
Most men damage their hormonal profile with alcohol, smoking, junk food, poor sleep and tap water, then blame genetics
Natural lifters boasting great genetics actually realized their potential through years of work
Steroid users bragging about genetics would shrivel and lose 50 lb in three months without drugs
Staying natural is the truest expression of your genetics, and lets you live past your 50s
Schrodinger's genetics: before working you can't know your potential; working actualizes good potential, not working proves bad potential
People told him for years lifting was a waste with his genetics, then later said he had good genetics all along
Someone training seriously for 10 years will have a good body, better than 99% of people, so everyone has good genetics
He thought he had bad calves and high lat insertions, but his back grew a lot in eight months once he trained it properly
Work is the answer to everything, and you keep working until you die
